Do you want to go sailing, windsurfing, biking or just out of the door? This application shows the current local outdoor wind speed (in beaufort, mph and km/h) and direction, measured by a nearby weather station for which it uses your current location. 

Features:
- The background color changes with the wind speed
- The direction of the wind is shown on a live compass
- Change between different wind speed units (beaufort, mph, km/h, m/s, knots)
- Change arrow poining direction to either from wind or to wind (weather vane) 
- The wind is automatically updated every hour
- The location is automatically updated when you move more than 5 miles/10km
- The current wind date can be shared
- Support for iPhone X
- Support for the iPad multitasking (split view..)

Ad supported freeware

Are you looking for the Aurora app that is not just about the forecast? Hello aurora is a mobile application that will act as your best friend when it comes to finding the Northern Lights.

Many of you may feel exhausted and lost when trying to understand the possibility of seeing the Northern Lights. You can forget about the unnecessary worries now! Because you will have everything you need for Northern Lights hunting in one app and can also share your aurora experience and connect with others aurora lovers! Here is what hello aurora can help you: 

* Real-time aurora forecast: data updated every few minutes from accurate real-time sources.
* Northern Lights Locations: Users can see and share their locations when spotted the Northern Lights. 
* Aurora Moments: Share the photo of the aurora you are seeing to other users with location, time, and aurora strength and choose emoji to react to the photos.
* Connect with aurora lovers: add information to your profile and get to know other enthusiasts.
* Your aurora hunting stats: keep your aurora stats such as how many aurora you have seen, your moments shared, and see how many people have seen your moments.
* Northern Lights alert: Notification sends to users when the aurora is visible at their location. 
* Aurora possibility: display the chance of seeing the Northern Lights. 
* Aurora Oval: Aurora belt display on the map screen. 
* Long-term forecast: Long-term 27 days Northern Lights forecast. 
* Aurora parameter: Each parameter you will need to take into account when observing the Northern Lights is explained in an easy way to understand. 
* Weather alerts: Notify users of the weather alerts and warnings around their location (currently only available in Iceland and we are working on adding to other countries as well). 
* Clouds map: high, middle, and low clouds overlay available on the map (only available in Iceland at the moment, but we will add to other countries soon).
* Road condition: Road information available in Iceland.

We also offer a pro account subscription. Below are some of the features you will have access to:

* Display your gallery of stunning moments on your profile and let other aurora enthusiasts discover and browse through all of your photos.
* Do you want to know how many aurora you spotted, moments you shared, and how many people reacted? We got you covered and you will see them all.
* You can set notifications by ranges of kilometers around your location. It helps to get more precise alerts when someone spots an aurora.
